newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks ease in London, bank shares weigh.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks ease in London, bank shares weigh.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were slightly weaker in London on Friday, led by bank shares, amid ongoing worries that U.S. interest rates were poised to rise, dealers said.
Bank shares took the biggest hit, losing about HK$1 from their Hong Kong close, dealers said.
At 1600 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference index was down 25.10 points to 12,464.20 in thin trading.
Dealers said an early decline on Wall Street contributed to the weakness in Hong Kong shares.
"People are just a bit cautious ahead of next week's Fed meeting," said one dealer.
The Federal Reserve Open Market Committee, the policy-making arm of the U.S. Federal Reserve, is set to meet on March 25.
In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng share index rose 16.97 points to 12,489.30.
